pesa.title: Public Expenditure Statistical Analyses 2026 (PESA)
pesa.about: The Treasury's yearly statistics on what government spends: by department, by purpose, by type of spending and by region. Accredited official statistics.

govuk_orgs.title: GOV.UK Organisations API
govuk_orgs.about: The official list of government organisations. The link from each department to a cabinet role and remit group is our own hand-kept mapping.

spend_dft.title: DfT: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_dft.released: monthly; latest file May 2026, published 24 September 2026
spend_dft.about: Every payment over £25,000, each month, as published by the department.

spend_ho.title: Home Office spending over £25,000 (and IOPC)
spend_ho.released: yearly publications of monthly files; latest July 2026
spend_ho.about: Monthly files of payments over £25,000 for the Home Office and the Independent Office for Police Conduct.

spend_dwp.title: DWP: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_dwp.about: Invoice lines grouped under payments over £25,000.

spend_dhsc.title: DHSC spending over £25,000
spend_dhsc.publisher: Department of Health and Social Care
spend_dhsc.released: monthly; latest file April 2026, published July 2026
spend_dhsc.about: Payments over £25,000 by the department itself; NHS England, trusts and councils publish their own.

spend_dfe.title: DfE: department and executive agency spend over £25,000
spend_dfe.released: yearly publications of monthly files; latest June 2026
spend_dfe.about: Payments over £25,000 by the department and its executive agencies.

spend_mod.title: MOD: spending over £25,000 (finance transparency dataset)
spend_mod.released: yearly publications of monthly spreadsheets; latest March 2026

dwp_benefit_tables.title: Benefit expenditure and caseload tables 2026 (Spring Forecast)
dwp_benefit_tables.about: Spending and number of claims for every benefit, 1948/49 to 2030/31 (outturn and forecast).

dwp_fraud_error.title: Fraud and error in the benefit system: financial year ending (FYE) 2026 estimates
dwp_fraud_error.about: Sample-based estimates of overpayments and underpayments by benefit, with ranges.

dwp_ara.title: DWP annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
dwp_ara.about: The department's audited accounts, including spending by budget line.

uc_health.title: Universal Credit Health statistics, April 2019 to June 2026
uc_health.about: People on Universal Credit with a health condition, by area and over time. Published from Stat-Xplore.

take_up.title: Income-related benefits: estimates of take-up, financial year ending 2024
take_up.about: How many of the people entitled to Pension Credit and pensioner Housing Benefit actually claim.

ons_population.title: Population estimates for England and Wales: mid-2025 (and UK mid-year estimates)
ons_population.about: Resident population by local authority, age and sex, retrieved through the Nomis service (dataset NM_2002_1).

census_disability.title: Census 2021: Disability by sex by age (RM073), England and Wales
census_disability.about: Self-reported disability under the Equality Act, by local authority and age band.

imd2025.title: English indices of deprivation 2025: local authority district summaries
imd2025.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
imd2025.about: Relative deprivation of English areas; rank 1 is the most deprived of 296 districts.

companies_house.title: Companies House: Free Company Data Product (basic company data), snapshot 1 October 2026
companies_house.about: The register of UK companies: name, number, status, type, accounts category, address, activity codes.

contracts_finder.title: Contracts Finder: award notices (Open Contracting Data Standard)
contracts_finder.about: Contract awards published by public buyers. Values are whole-contract values, not annual spending.

dft_accounts.title: DfT annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
dft_accounts.publisher: Department for Transport; certificate by the Comptroller and Auditor General
dft_accounts.about: Audited accounts: spending by programme (p.18), assets under construction (p.26), cash reconciliation including grant-in-aid to arm's-length bodies (SOPS 3, p.164).

hmrc_income_tax.title: Income Tax liabilities statistics (Tables 2.1 to 2.6, survey year 2023-24 with HMRC projections to 2026-27) and percentile tables 3.1a
hmrc_income_tax.released: July 2026 (Income Tax liabilities statistics); Personal incomes statistics 2023-24
hmrc_income_tax.about: Income Tax payers by rate band, sex, age and region; shares of income and tax by percentile group; liabilities by income range and by source of income. Based on the Survey of Personal Incomes; the latest survey year is 2023-24, later years are projections.

hmrc_receipts.title: HMRC tax and National Insurance contributions receipts for the UK
hmrc_receipts.about: Cash receipts by tax and financial year, including PAYE, Self Assessment, employer and employee NICs, VAT, Corporation Tax and duties. Excludes Council Tax and business rates.

hmrc_tax_gap.title: Measuring tax gaps 2026 edition: tax gap tables for 2024 to 2025
hmrc_tax_gap.about: HMRC's estimate of tax owed but not paid by tax type and customer group since 2005-06.

ons_etb.title: The effects of taxes and benefits on household income, UK: financial year ending 2024 (reference tables)
ons_etb.about: Average household income, taxes and benefits (cash and in kind) by income group, retired status, children, tenure and region, from the Household Finances Survey.

mhclg_la_finance.title: Local authority revenue expenditure and financing England: revenue outturn multi-year time series (2017-18 to 2025-26) and 2026-27 revenue account budget
mhclg_la_finance.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
mhclg_la_finance.about: Each English council's own returns of net current expenditure by service and how it is financed, in GBP thousand. Accredited Official Statistics.

mhclg_council_tax.title: Council Tax levels set by local authorities in England 2026 to 2027
mhclg_council_tax.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
mhclg_council_tax.about: Average Band D Council Tax by authority, with the adult social care precept and parish precepts.

ons_census_2021.title: Census 2021 bulk tables for England and Wales (TS001 to TS067 output-area tables)
ons_census_2021.about: Usual residents by age, sex, economic activity, disability, health, country of birth, passports, length of residence, ethnic group, religion, tenure, qualifications and occupation, at output area level, here added up to constituencies and local authorities.

ons_postcode_directory.title: ONS Postcode Directory (May 2026) and ONS best-fit lookups from Census 2021 output areas to Westminster constituencies (July 2024)
ons_postcode_directory.publisher: Office for National Statistics (Open Geography Portal)
ons_postcode_directory.about: Which constituency, local authority, region and census output area each UK postcode is in; and the output area to constituency lookup. Used for geography only.

dwp_statxplore.title: DWP Stat-Xplore: Universal Credit, PIP, Pension Credit, Attendance Allowance, Carer's Allowance, State Pension, ESA, DLA, Housing Benefit, children in low income families, NINo registrations (open data API, constituency and local authority tables)
dwp_statxplore.released: UC May 2026; PIP July 2026; most others March 2026; children in low income 2024/25; NINo to 2025/26
dwp_statxplore.about: DWP's own small-area benefit statistics, queried through the Stat-Xplore API for every Westminster constituency and local authority in Great Britain (NINo registrations also cover Northern Ireland). Counts are rounded by DWP.

home_office_ist.title: Immigration system statistics, year ending June 2026 (summary tables and detailed datasets)
home_office_ist.about: Quarterly Accredited Official Statistics on asylum claims, decisions, support and accommodation, illegal entry routes and small boats, returns, detention, visas, resettlement, citizenship and age assessments.

ons_ltim.title: Long-term international immigration, emigration and net migration flows, provisional: year ending December 2025
ons_ltim.about: Immigration, emigration and net migration by rolling year from year ending June 2012, by British, EU+ and non-EU+ nationality, with the ONS's revision history.

nao_asylum_system.title: An analysis of the asylum system (summary)
nao_asylum_system.about: NAO systems map of the asylum system with the direct cost of supporting people seeking asylum.

nao_aasc.title: The Home Office's asylum accommodation contracts (summary)
nao_aasc.about: Briefing for the Home Affairs Committee on the seven regional asylum accommodation contracts: cost estimates, hotel share, supplier profit and performance. Supplier data not audited by the NAO.

nao_asylum_accommodation_2024.title: Investigation into asylum accommodation (summary)
nao_asylum_accommodation_2024.about: Hotel spending, the large sites programme (Bibby Stockholm, Wethersfield, Scampton, Huddersfield), and the Home Office's own value-for-money comparison.

nao_northeye.title: Investigation into the acquisition of the Northeye site for asylum accommodation (summary)
nao_northeye.about: How the Home Office bought a former prison site at Bexhill and why it was not operational.

ho_accounts.title: Home Office annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 (Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Net Expenditure)
ho_accounts.publisher: Home Office; certificate by the Comptroller and Auditor General
ho_accounts.about: Audited accounts. Lines for the core department and agencies were transcribed by hand with page numbers and checked to add to the published total.

cs_statistics.title: Civil Service Statistics: 2026 (statistical tables)
cs_statistics.about: Headcount and full-time equivalent of civil servants by department and agency, grade, region, profession, sex, entrants and leavers, with median salary by grade.

workforce_mi.title: Departmental workforce management information (monthly)
workforce_mi.released: monthly; latest month 2026-01 to 2026-08 depending on the department
workforce_mi.about: Payroll staff by grade as headcount and full-time equivalent, non-payroll staff, consultancy contracts and payroll costs, including arm's-length bodies. Internal management information, not official statistics.

dept_ara.title: Departmental annual reports and accounts 2025 to 2026 (Statement of Outturn against Parliamentary Supply)
dept_ara.publisher: Each department; audited by the Comptroller and Auditor General
dept_ara.released: June to September 2026 (each department's own date)
dept_ara.about: The Supply Estimate (what Parliament voted) against outturn by control total, from the summary table in each department's accounts. Transcribed and checked; the department's own page names the accounts used.

grants_register.title: Government grants register 2024 to 2025: scheme and award data (and Government grants statistical tables)
grants_register.publisher: Cabinet Office, Government Grants Management Function
grants_register.about: Every grant scheme (funder, value, allocation method, legal basis) and individual award (recipient, company or charity number, postcode, amount) reported by departments.

obr_databank.title: OBR public finances databank (September 2026) and historical public finances database
obr_databank.released: September 2026; outturn to 2025-26 (provisional), forecast to 2030-31 from the March 2026 Economic and fiscal outlook
obr_databank.about: Receipts, spending, borrowing, debt, debt interest and GDP in cash and as a share of GDP since 1946-47 (and since 1900 as shares of GDP), with the OBR's forecast.

nista_gmpp.title: NISTA Major Projects Annual Report 2025-26: data (Government Major Projects Portfolio)
nista_gmpp.publisher: National Infrastructure and Service Transformation Authority
nista_gmpp.released: 13 July 2026; position reported by departments at 31 March 2026
nista_gmpp.about: 189 major projects with delivery confidence ratings, dates, whole-life costs, in-year budget variance and exemptions.

dwp_restart.title: Restart Scheme statistics to April 2026 (tables) and Restart Scheme provider guidance: contract package areas annex
dwp_restart.released: 4 June 2026 (statistics, official statistics in development); annex updated 13 July 2026
dwp_restart.about: Referrals, starts and job outcomes by contract package area against contractual expectations, and each area's provider and local authorities.

dwp_accounts.title: DWP annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026 (Accountability report: losses, special payments, contingent liabilities, audit certificate)
dwp_accounts.publisher: Department for Work and Pensions; certificate by the Comptroller and Auditor General
dwp_accounts.about: Audited accounts. These notes exist only in the PDF, so they were transcribed by hand with page numbers into registry/dwp_*_2025_26.csv.

dwp_unfulfilled.title: Unfulfilled eligibility in the benefit system: financial year ending (FYE) 2026 estimates
dwp_unfulfilled.about: Sample-based estimate of how much more claimants could have been paid had they reported their circumstances accurately, by benefit and reason.

nao_reports.title: National Audit Office reports (list from the NAO website's open API)
nao_reports.released: live; downloaded 14 October 2026 (2,784 reports, 1984 to September 2026)
nao_reports.about: Title, date, department tag, report type and the NAO's own one-sentence summary of each report it has published. Findings are in the linked reports.

pac_reports.title: Public Accounts Committee publications (Parliament committees API)
pac_reports.publisher: House of Commons Public Accounts Committee
pac_reports.released: live; downloaded 14 October 2026 (805 reports, 2010 to October 2026)
pac_reports.about: The committee's formally agreed reports with titles, dates, report numbers and links. Recommendations are in the linked reports.

spend_desnz.title: DESNZ: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_desnz.publisher: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero
spend_desnz.released: monthly; latest file December 2025, published 24 September 2026
spend_desnz.about: Payments over £25,000. A separate £500 series on the same site is only purchase-card spending.

spend_mhclg.title: MHCLG: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_mhclg.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
spend_mhclg.about: Date, supplier, description and amount only. One file covers the whole department.

spend_hmrc.title: HMRC: spending over £25,000
spend_hmrc.released: monthly; latest file August 2026, published 30 September 2026
spend_hmrc.about: Payments over £25,000, mostly IT and running costs.

spend_moj.title: Ministry of Justice: departmental spending over £25,000 (headquarters, prisons and probation, courts, legal aid and arm's-length bodies)
spend_moj.released: monthly; April 2025 to February 2026 loaded, published between March and September 2026
spend_moj.about: Fifteen separate monthly files (MoJ HQ, HMPPS, HMCTS, Legal Aid Agency and eleven arm's-length bodies) in one common layout.

spend_defra.title: Defra: departmental spending over £25,000 (core department and arm's-length bodies)
spend_defra.publisher: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
spend_defra.released: monthly; April 2025 to February 2026 loaded; published up to October 2026
spend_defra.about: Payments over £25,000 by Defra and bodies such as the Environment Agency, Natural England and the Animal and Plant Health Agency, with supplier postcode and type.

spend_dsit.title: DSIT: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_dsit.publisher: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
spend_dsit.released: monthly; April to December 2025 loaded (the 2025 publication, 30 July 2026)
spend_dsit.about: Payments over £25,000, mostly grant-in-aid to UKRI research councils and arm's-length bodies. The separate 'over £500' series is government procurement cards only.

spend_hmt.title: HM Treasury: spending over £25,000
spend_hmt.released: monthly; latest file March 2026, published 30 April 2026
spend_hmt.about: Payments over £25,000 by the Treasury and its agencies (DMO, GIAA, UKGI).

spend_nhse.title: NHS England: payments over £25k reports
spend_nhse.released: yearly pages of monthly spreadsheets; latest September 2025, published July 2026
spend_nhse.about: NHS England's own payments over £25,000 from its accounts-payable ledger, including its commissioning support units.

nhse_accounts.title: NHS England annual report and accounts 2024 to 2025
nhse_accounts.about: Audited accounts, including the note breaking down operating expenses of NHS England and of the group with integrated care boards.

spend_fcdo.title: FCDO: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_fcdo.released: monthly; the last file published is for January 2025
spend_fcdo.about: Invoice lines of payments over £25,000. Files stop at January 2025.

spend_dbt.title: DBT: departmental spending over £25,000
spend_dbt.released: monthly; latest file July 2026, published 24 September 2026

ons_pse.title: Public sector employment, UK: June 2026 (reference table)
ons_pse.about: Quarterly headcount and full-time equivalent employment of the whole UK public sector since 1999, by sector (central government, local government, public corporations, Civil Service) and by industry (NHS, education, police, armed forces, public administration).

nhs_workforce.title: NHS Workforce Statistics (hospital and community health service, HCHS), July 2026
nhs_workforce.released: monthly; July 2026 edition (staff in post at 31 July 2026)
nhs_workforce.about: Full-time equivalent and headcount of NHS hospital and community staff in England by staff group, grade, nationality, region, integrated care system and organisation, from the Electronic Staff Record. Excludes GPs and their practice staff, social care and agency staff.

dfe_school_workforce.title: School workforce in England: November 2025
dfe_school_workforce.about: Teachers and support staff in state-funded schools in England: full-time equivalent and headcount by school type, region, local authority and constituency, and teacher pay (Teacher Pension Scheme data).

ho_police_workforce.title: Police workforce, England and Wales: 31 March 2026
ho_police_workforce.released: 22 July 2026; officers and staff at 31 March 2026
ho_police_workforce.about: Police officers by force area, rank and sex, police staff, community support officers and special constables, with the series back to 2003.

mod_service_personnel.title: UK armed forces quarterly service personnel statistics: 1 July 2026
mod_service_personnel.about: Strength of the UK regular forces, Gurkhas and reserves, intake and outflow, rank structure, and service personnel alongside MoD civil servants.
